decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (501 (received 17/04/2014)
C101 Rev A (received 10/06/2014)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall be in accordance with the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the garages the existing roller shutter shall be removed and the wall and gate implemented in accordance with the approved plans.
description: Demolition of existing garages and erection of a double garage and wall
